howe_sound.label: Howe Sound
howe_sound.text: Today Tonight and Sunday. Strong wind warning in effect. Wind northerly outflow 20 to 30 knots diminishing to light this morning then becoming southerly inflow 5 to 15 near noon. Wind becoming light early this evening then increasing to northerly outflow 15 to 25 late this evening. Wind diminishing to light Sunday morning then becoming southerly inflow 5 to 15 near noon Sunday. Wind becoming light Sunday evening.

hours.reason: Classic Squamish summer thermal: valley heats, draws air up Howe Sound from the south. Multiple models agree, which is a good sign for a thermal-driven day. Solar loading is strong (~659 W/m²) — good thermal driver. Field-calibrated: raw coarse-model wind (~5kt) is scaled up ~2.85x, matching how this thermal typically under-reads on GFS-class models (source: local rider calibration, see README). Caution: MSLP doesn't clearly support inflow yet (large-scale -0.4hPa, local -0.1hPa) — could be weaker or more marginal than the wind signal alone suggests. EC marine forecast for this area: southerly 5-15kt near noon.
hours.summary: Afternoon sea-breeze pattern — builds through the day, fades around sunset.
